gaps.lead: The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.lead: You must complete the form in ink.
gaps.explanation: must complete → must be completed (modal + be + participle).

gaps.lead: It wasn't necessary for her to bring any food — there was plenty.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it wasn't necessary, but she did it.

gaps.answer: to put up with any rudeness
gaps.lead: Delia said that she would no longer tolerate her colleagues being rude.
gaps.sentence: 'I am not willing ___ from my colleagues any longer,' said Delia.
gaps.explanation: 'Not willing to put up with rudeness' means will no longer tolerate it.

gaps.lead: He had just sat down when the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: No sooner had + subject + participle … than…
